LandingPage.heroTagline: Data publishing at any scale for everyone.
LandingPage.heroBody: Upload, share, and access data without needing to build or maintain your own infrastructure.
LandingPage.challenge1: Scientific data infrastructure wasn't built for cross-border, cross-sector cooperation.
LandingPage.challenge2: Addressing global challenges means combining data from governments, research institutions, commercial providers, and civil society—each with its own formats, access patterns, and APIs.
LandingPage.challenge3: Data engineers, scientists, and researchers spend more time wrangling infrastructure than doing their actual work, hampering collaboration and limiting informed decision making.
LandingPage.solution1: Source is a nonprofit data publishing utility built on commodity cloud object storage. Researchers publish data at any scale without running servers, building portals, or writing APIs.
LandingPage.solution2: Source handles cloud infrastructure so researchers can focus on their data, not their hosting. Users access everything through standard URLs that work with existing tools—no custom portals, no proprietary APIs.
LandingPage.solution3: The service is intentionally commoditized: built to resist lock-in and designed so that no single provider, funder, or political decision can make research data disappear.
LandingPage.integrateBody: Source is a vendor-neutral data publishing utility that works with any S3-compatible cloud provider.
LandingPage.neutralBody: Retain full ownership and control of your data. Source supports open formats and is a non-commercial repository, so you're never trapped by proprietary APIs or workflows.
LandingPage.pricing1: Instead of building and maintaining data portals or trying to wrangle variable cloud costs, Source lets you focus on the fundamentals that make data easy to publish and easy to use.
LandingPage.pricing2: Pricing plans based on data volume and usage will be announced soon.
LandingPage.caseStudiesHeading: Open Source, Governed, and Trusted By These Teams
LandingPage.builtForHeading: Built for Data Engineers, Scientists, and Developers
LandingPage.builtForBody: Source Cooperative supports your data lifecycle, from prototyping to public release, without navigating corporate cloud policies.
